QuestInfo.name: [Ariant] A Fairy's Trail
QuestInfo.1: Until recently, Areda was a teacher at Ellinel Fairy Academy teaching about potions. By concocting with Mandraky, she was able to create a potion that robs someone of their free will. She was kicked out after being caught using it on students. It was then revealed that she'd been faking being a fairy even then. The headmistress tells you that she's originally from Magatia.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Carson, the Zenumist President, about Areda in Magatia.
QuestInfo.0: It seems the headmistress of Ellinel Fairy Academy knows Areda. But...she's not a fairy?
